settingsAppearance.clock.label: Time format
settingsAppearance.clock.note: How every instant in this app is written — a job's start, a credential's expiry, a command's round trip. Dates follow your device's own language, and every time is shown in your device's timezone, not the server's.
settingsAppearance.defaultViews.label: Default view per listing
settingsAppearance.defaultViews.note: Which shape each listing opens in. The toggle on every screen still switches at any time — this is only where it starts.
settingsAppearance.home.allPrintersNote: Always open on the printers list, with the severity sort, the filters and the table mode.
settingsAppearance.home.autoNote: One or two printers open large on the printer itself, without the filters or the pager; three or more open on the printers list.
settingsAppearance.home.dashboardNote: Open on the dashboard of this server: the default one, or one made from your printers when there is none.
settingsAppearance.home.label: Home page
settingsAppearance.home.myPrinterNote: Always open on the printer last looked at, however many this instance has.
settingsAppearance.home.note: Which page this app opens on. The choice decides where you land, never what you can reach — the printers list stays in the navigation at every setting.
settingsAppearance.look.title: Look
settingsAppearance.open.title: Where things open
settingsAppearance.reading.title: Reading
settingsAppearance.rows.label: Rows per page
settingsAppearance.rows.note: How many rows a listing opens with. A listing whose pager you have already used keeps the size you set there.
settingsAppearance.skin.hint.prusapro: The palette the professional line is drawn in.
settingsAppearance.skin.hint.slicer: The palette PrusaSlicer is drawn in.
settingsAppearance.skin.label: Skin
settingsAppearance.skin.note: Which set of colours, corners and spacing this app is drawn with. Independent of light and dark — each skin carries both, and picking one repaints the whole app at once, which is the only honest preview of it.
settingsAppearance.temperature.label: Temperature
settingsAppearance.temperature.note: What a reading is written as. Printers report and accept Celsius either way, so this changes the words and never what is sent.
settingsAppearance.theme.hint.dark: Dark at every hour, whatever the device is set to.
settingsAppearance.theme.hint.light: Light at every hour, whatever the device is set to.
settingsAppearance.theme.hint.system: Reads the device, light or dark.
settingsAppearance.theme.label: Theme
settingsAppearance.theme.note: The same preference the header carries, stored per browser.
settingsAppearance.title: Appearance
